title: Dynamic-scale fuzzing and calibration trace for FP8/INT8 function-call JSON fidelity
creator: Ethan Chen
description: We need a robust, reproducible test harness and calibration-trace instrumentation that validates structured function-call JSON adhereance when models are served with FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. Prior work focused on static calibration runs and unit schema checks; this ticket creates a dynamic-scale fuzzing flow that records per-token scale/zero-point traces during calibration and compares downstream JSON shape/typing fidelity across quantized variants.
background: Recent internal alerts showed intermittent schema mismatches for function-call outputs under low-precision kernels on long chat contexts. Root cause hypotheses include dynamic range clipping during KV cache updates and per-layer scale quantization jitter that alters tokenization or emits unexpected nulls for optional fields. Existing tests exercise deterministic prompts but don't stress rare token sequences or mixed-type containers (lists of dicts, nested optionals).
investigation_notes: 2026-02-21: Reproduced a schema mismatch with fp8-e4m3 config on convo length > 2048 using the payment_formatted_example prompt from customer-qa suite.
2026-02-24: Added per-layer scale logging in dev runtime; observed spikes in scale magnitude on attention layers after repeated prefix caching.
2026-02-28: Built a small token-level replay harness that replays tokens into quantized runtime with identical KV cache ops to validate deterministic outputs.
2026-03-04: Implemented structured-fuzz generator to produce nested argument shapes (optional ints, lists, maps) and corner values (empty lists, large numbers, unicode control chars).

2026-03-10: Early CI run shows ~0.9% schema-failure rate on INT8 calibration profile with our current 10k-example fuzz corpus; investigating false positives from whitespace/ordering differences in serialized JSON.

2026-03-12: Tightened comparator to canonicalize JSON (sort keys, normalize whitespace) and re-run — failure rate dropped to 0.23% and concentrated on numeric rounding differences and missing optional fields.
Next step: correlate failures with per-token scale traces and attention-layer scale delta thresholds to find deterministic triggers.
decision_log: Adopt dynamic per-token scale tracing for all calibration runs used by the fuzz harness (decision 2026-03-05).
Canonicalize JSON before comparison in tests to avoid non-semantic diffs (decision 2026-03-11).
Define a two-tiered acceptance criteria: schema conformance strict for required fields; tolerant numeric comparison for floats with configurable eps by profile (decision 2026-03-12).
acceptance_criteria: Fuzz harness integrated into CI: nightly run generates and validates >= 10k structured prompts across fp8/int8/float32 and reliably records per-token scale traces.
Overall schema-pass rate >= 99.9% for required fields across 30k combined examples; failures must include per-token trace and model seed to reproduce.
For numeric fields: implement configurable epsilon thresholds by model/profile in test config; default epsilon for INT8 set to 1e-2, for FP8 5e-3.
All failures triaged automatically: output includes stack of attention layer scales, KV cache ops indices, and a minimized repro prompt that triggers the failure in < 1000 tokens.
New tests added to the regression suite and gated behind runtime-1.22 release; no schema regressions allowed for customer-facing function-call endpoints in canary region.
Documentation updated: short how-to for debugging quantization-induced schema issues and instructions to run the harness locally.
test_plan: Create seed corpus: merge customer-qa prompts, synthetic nested-structure generator, and a unicode/control-char set (target 20k unique samples).
Run baseline on float32 to establish canonical outputs and store canonicalized JSON and tokenization traces.
Instrument fp8 and int8 calibration runs to capture per-token scales and layer-level quantization deltas into trace artifact (binary protobuf -> trace JSON for CI artifacts).
Fuzz run: for each sample, compare canonicalized JSON from quantized run with baseline using structural comparator; if mismatch, attach traces and run minimizer to shrink prompt to root cause.
Aggregate failures and compute metrics: pass rate, failure taxonomy (missing required key, type mismatch, numeric rounding, ordering-only), and per-layer delta correlation.
Run nightly CI for 14 days and require PR owners to investigate regressions flagged by the harness before merge to main runtime branch.
implementation_steps: Extend runtime telemetry: add per-token scale and zero-point logging for attention and linear layers behind a feature flag.
Add canonicalizer module to test harness: stable key ordering, normalization for float formatting, trim insignificant whitespace and control characters.
Implement structured fuzz generator with seeds and mutation operators (insert empty list, swap types in list, truncate nested maps).
Create repro minimizer that uses binary search on prompt tokens and structure mutations to find smallest failing input.
Wire harness into CI as nightly job and add special 'regression' group that alerts on >0.05% increase in failure rate vs baseline.
Add dashboards: per-profile failure rate, top failing seeds, layer-delta heatmap.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): land telemetry and harness behind feature flag on dev and staging clusters; run 2-week soak.
Phase 2 (canary): enable on runtime canary region (small percentage of dedicated capacity) and block merges if new failures are introduced.
Phase 3 (prod): enable full-nightly harness and require green before runtime-1.22 train release; include a rollback playbook if we discover systemic FP8 issues.
Communication: notify Solutions Eng and Support about the new diagnostics; provide a runbook for triage on customer reports.
qa_notes: Make sure reproducibility: all traces must include random seed and tokenizer version.
Confirm minimizer preserves structure until failure disappears — avoids producing spurious minimal examples that change failure class.
Validate telemetry overhead: feature flag must be off by default in production to avoid perf regression.
notes_for_followup: If failures correlate to specific tokenizer tokens, partner with Tokenization team to check tokenization stability under quantized runtimes.
Consider adding lightweight runtime assertions that catch and rewrite invalid JSON (as a last-resort fallback) to preserve customer API contracts.
Explore baking small deterministic calibration runs into model packaging so that per-deployment calibration variance is reduced.
